calls.title: AI Engineer World's Fair Post-Event Debrief
calls.summary: The sales team debriefed the AI Engineer World's Fair, discussing GrowthBook's product (experimentation and feature flags). Key pain points included confusing booth messaging around agentic workflows, lower traffic due to booth location, and an audience more interested in feature flags than experiments. Key participants were Lyndsie Berens (organizer), Ashley Stirrup
